catalog.name: Selom ERG Flicker
catalog.summary: Light-adapted flicker ERG as a publication figure — steady-state waveform small-multiples (flicker frequency down the rows, conditions across the columns, one shared scale bar) or the N1→P1 amplitude-versus-frequency summary. The periodic-response figure the flash trace grid can't make: the N1→P1 amplitude (trough-to-peak) + P1 implicit time are measured from the phase-averaged steady-state cycle, with no a-/b-wave or Naka-Rushton language. Reads the long ERG waveform table; condition colours + order match the trace grid; attaches a per-condition N1/P1 table.
